buildbot.title: BuildVolt — PC-Build Recommendation SaaS
buildbot.description: Our final year project, built with a 2-person team: a deterministic compatibility engine that infers CPU/RAM/PSU specs from catalog text and assembles budget-capped, safety-checked PC builds — plus a WordPress/WooCommerce plugin and a React + TypeScript store dashboard for catalog sync, CSV import, and analytics.

nodemart.title: NodeMart Product Marketplace (MERN)
nodemart.description: A full-stack product marketplace with JWT-authenticated accounts and owner-scoped product CRUD. Supports image uploads to Cloudinary, product search, price filters, sorting, and pagination, with React/Vite and an Express/MongoDB API deployed on Vercel.

Complain-Management-System-MERN.title: Smart Complaint Management System (MERN Stack)
Complain-Management-System-MERN.description: A role-based complaint-management platform: citizens file complaints, staff move them through a Pending → In Progress → Resolved/Rejected lifecycle, and admins approve accounts and oversee the queue — across 15 REST endpoints guarded by JWT auth and bcrypt password hashing.

shopco-ecommerce.title: Shop.co E-Commerce Platform (MERN Stack)
shopco-ecommerce.description: A pixel-faithful rebuild of a community Figma template as a full MERN application — product filtering, search and pagination, reviews, promo-code validation, and order placement, backed by a MongoDB Atlas-seeded catalog.

Multi-pages-website-react.title: Multi-Page E-Commerce Website
Multi-pages-website-react.description: A multi-page storefront built in React during my NAVTTC-affiliated full-stack training — catalog, product detail, and cart flows wired together with client-side routing.

full-stack-auth.title: Full-Stack Auth
full-stack-auth.description: A self-contained authentication reference app: signup, login, JWT-protected profile routes, and persisted sessions — the pattern I reuse as the backbone for every app that needs real users.

students-Records-app.title: Student Records App
students-Records-app.description: A type-safe full-stack app (Next.js App Router, TypeScript, MongoDB/Mongoose) with a typed Student schema and REST-style API routes for full CRUD, plus an admin dashboard surfacing live enrollment metrics — total, active, inactive, new-this-month — with search and end-to-end form validation.

MuhammadHussain-mern-10pshine.title: NoteFlow — 10Pearls Internship Project
MuhammadHussain-mern-10pshine.description: Built during my MERN Stack Development internship at 10Pearls (10Shine Program): a full-stack notes application with JWT authentication, email verification, and full CRUD, plus data import/export and user profile management.
